rule: Stratified by category (adversarial cases, ids starting with X, are their own stratum). Within a stratum the cases are ordered by sha256(salt:id) and the first round(fraction * size) become test (strata under 3 cases stay in dev). Existing assignments are frozen; new cases are assigned by scripts/freeze_split.py --add-new.
policy: Tune on dev. Run test to report a number. Do not change prompts, thresholds or routing because of an individual test failure; if you do, move that case to dev in the same commit and record why in docs/FINDINGS.md.
